source_direction.text: Wide arena reveal. Exact Grand Puff lands with one soft squash-and-settle motion: three-tier smoky-grey/lavender body, deep-plum curls, huge symmetrical spiral ears with pearl joints, pearl paws, curl crest, glossy plum eyes, coral blush, compact grin with exactly two small pearl teeth. He holds a clear cute identity pose, then his lavender four-point forehead sparkle gives the same playful vulnerability pulse as gameplay. Roshan remains safely at edge. Locked camera. End with Grand Puff upright, smiling, and the tell readable. No smoke body, attack, sharp teeth, injury, title text, HUD, or defeat pose. Sound: temporary soft puffy landing, comic bounce, and bright tell chime; no voices.
